'''Emily Woo Zeller''' is an American voice actress for the English-language [[dub]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Zeller was born on November 11, 1983. As an adult, she became a voice actress and was involved with a number of English-dubbed versions of Japanese anime series. Zeller was mostly involved with {{wp|Animax Asia}}, which broadcasted Japanese anime, including alternate English-dubbed versions, in other Asian countries. She began working for {{aniseries|PTS}} during the {{aniseries|XY|''XY'' series}}, voicing two major characters: [[Team Flare]] scientist [[Bryony]] and [[Arche Valley]] resident [[Meray]].
